## Episode Thesis

This episode of the EuroInvestor podcast Millionærklubben is a pre-recorded interview between host Bodil Johanne Gansel and NNIT CEO Claus Rydkær, who took over from Per Fors in April 2026. Rydkær describes 2026 as a clean-up year after NNIT spread itself too thin. The new One NNIT 2030 strategy narrows the life-science service portfolio from more than 100 offerings to 15 'value paths' in R&D, manufacturing and supply chain, puts AI at the core of the business and aims to return to growth from 2027-2028. Nobody gives a buy or sell view; the tone is cautiously optimistic, but it comes from the company's own management.
